interface.title: MLOmics — Cancer Subtype Classifier (Latent-Fusion Multi-Omics Classifier)
interface.field: Cancer genomics / multi-omics machine learning (TCGA breast BRCA and colon COAD molecular subtyping)
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis and interpretation: classifying patient samples with pre-trained models, explaining the predictions, and benchmarking the models
interface.what_it_is_for: Upload one or more patients' mRNA/miRNA/methylation/CNV profiles, get a predicted molecular subtype with a confidence tier from XGBoost or one of two deep fusion models, read which features drove each call and which KEGG pathways the pathway-aware model weights most for the cohort, compare the models' cross-validated performance, and turn raw per-modality lab files into a prediction-ready row.

data.note: Used: sample_input_brca.csv (1 BRCA sample, also given by the in-app 'Download sample CSV' button), demo_patient_robert_okonkwo_COAD.csv (1 COAD patient), synthetic_coad_CMS1_MSI-Immune.csv (10 COAD samples), and the four amara_nwosu_*.csv per-modality files in the Data Converter. The Model Comparison tab shows built-in, precomputed 5-fold CV results. Not used: Sarah Mitchell BRCA demo, synthetic_brca_Basal-like.csv, sample_input_coad.csv. The AI Research Summary showed its expected 'GROQ_API_KEY not configured' message. The page first hung on 127.0.0.1 and loaded once opened on localhost:8501.

tree.general: Assign patients to molecular subgroups with trained classifiers, check that each call is believable, and judge which model to trust
tree.specific: Predict BRCA/COAD molecular subtypes from multi-omics profiles with XGBoost, IntermediateFusion or PathwayAwareFusion, explain them with SHAP / Integrated Gradients, view cohort-level KEGG pathway attention, and review the CV benchmark

features.name: Per-modality file converter with coverage report
features.general: Collect separate measurement files for one subject, say how they were scaled, map them onto the feature list the model expects, report how much of each block was matched, and save one model-ready row
features.specific: Lab Data Converter: Cancer Type + Patient ID + Data Format (z-scored / log2 / raw counts / beta) → four optional modality uploaders → Convert & Prepare File → per-modality coverage cards (e.g. miRNA 200/366) + normalisation warning → Download Prediction-Ready CSV

pick the input data format (sets the normalisation transform)
upload one CSV per modality (any subset)
press Convert & Prepare File
read the per-modality coverage percentages and warnings
download the 1-row prediction-ready CSV
serves_tasks: Convert, check how many expected features were found, and save the result
Load one data file per measurement type
Describe the patient and how their data were scaled

features.name: Model-switchable classification result cards with confidence tiers
features.general: Run uploaded samples through a model chosen from a list and show each sample's predicted class, probability and a confidence label, re-running the same data when the model is changed
features.specific: Sidebar Cancer Type + Select Model radios + CSV uploader → one Prediction Results card per sample (ID, subtype, %, MODERATE / HIGH CONFIDENCE) → Export predictions as CSV
steps: choose cohort and model in the sidebar
upload a CSV of one or many samples
read the per-sample cards
switch the model to compare the call on the same data
export predictions as CSV

Re-run the same patient with other models and compare

features.name: Sample picker driving the class-probability chart

open 'Select sample for detailed view'
choose a sample ID

features.name: Model-dependent attribution panel (SHAP waterfall or Integrated Gradients)
features.general: Explain one prediction by ranking input features by their signed push toward or away from the predicted class, using the explanation method that suits the model type
features.specific: Feature Importance section that swaps between a TreeSHAP waterfall (red toward / blue away, E[f(x)] → f(x)) for XGBoost and a Captum Integrated Gradients top-15 bar chart (blue / grey) plus a 'Top 20 features by modality' count for the fusion models; follows the sample chosen in the picker (f3); 'What is SHAP? / What are Integrated Gradients?' explainers
steps: select a model
read the ranked feature contributions
note modality from the feature prefix (mrna_/mirna_/methy_/cnv_) and the modality count line

See which input features pushed a neural model toward its call

features.name: Cohort-level pathway attention bar chart with hover and box zoom

features.specific: Top 10 Attended KEGG Pathways (GS-BRCA or GS-COAD) horizontal bars of precomputed cohort-mean attention, identical for every patient in the cohort, shown only for Pathway-Aware Fusion; Plotly hover tooltip, drag-box zoom, double-click to reset

read the top-10 pathways

drag a box to zoom the x-axis and see the differences
